variants.label: Column
variants.tooltip: A 12 column grid layout in which components can be organized. The columns that alter their layout depending on screen viewport size.

breakpoints.description: Width breakpoints declarations for child layouts. When container is sized below minWidth, child position rules will fall back to the next set breakpoint rules

currentBreakpoint.description: The name of the currently applied breakpoint (read-only).

gutters.description: Amount of space, in pixels, to place between child components

height.description: Component height. Rows adjust height to accommodate components. Use 'auto' to let component content (such as text) dictate height.

name.description: Name of a breakpoint defined in container. If this matches the currently applied breakpoint, these rules determine child layout.

span.description: Number of columns the child's width will span.

rowIndex.description: Row index (starting from 0) in which to place child. Children may wrap lines within a row. Children in separate rows don't affect each other's layout

colIndex.description: Column number upon which the child's span should begin unless forced to wrap.

order.description: Where component is placed among its siblings within its row. Ordering is independent per row.
